ex.en: Rainforests have amazing biodiversity.
ex.zh: 雨林擁有驚人的生物多樣性。

ex.en: Pollution is a threat to marine biodiversity.
ex.zh: 污染威脅著海洋的生物多樣性。

biodiversity.en: the large variety of plants and animals living in a place

ex.en: These bags are made of biodegradable plastic.
ex.zh: 這些袋子是用可分解塑膠做的。

ex.en: Choose biodegradable cleaning products.
ex.zh: 選擇可生物分解的清潔用品。

biodegradable.en: able to break down naturally without harming nature

ex.en: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
ex.zh: 你生日的時候我會送你一輛腳踏車。

ex.en: I don't have a bicycle, let alone a car.
ex.zh: 我連腳踏車都沒有，更別說汽車了。

ex.en: It cost me 5,000 yen to repair my bicycle.
ex.zh: 修我的腳踏車花了五千日圓。

bicycle.en: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals

ex.en: You'll get a lot of presents on your birthday.
ex.zh: 你生日那天會收到很多禮物。

ex.en: My father bought me a camera for my birthday.
ex.zh: 我爸爸買了一台相機給我當生日禮物。

ex.en: My mother put thirteen candles on my birthday cake.
ex.zh: 媽媽在我的生日蛋糕上插了十三根蠟燭。

birthday.en: the day each year when you remember the day you were born

ex.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
ex.zh: 他是哈佛大學的生物學教授。

ex.en: He is very much interested in biology.
ex.zh: 他對生物學非常有興趣。

ex.en: She'll write a book on biology.
ex.zh: 她將寫一本關於生物學的書。

biology.en: the science that studies living things

ex.en: I'm reading a biography of Steve Jobs.
ex.zh: 我正在看賈伯斯的傳記。

ex.en: Her biography became a best-seller.
ex.zh: 她的傳記成了暢銷書。

biography.en: a book about a person's life written by someone else

ex.en: The house was sold to the highest bidder.
ex.zh: 房子賣給了出價最高的人。

ex.en: Three bidders competed for the contract.
ex.zh: 有三家廠商競標這份合約。

bidder.en: a person who offers an amount of money to buy something

ex.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
ex.zh: 兩國簽署了雙邊貿易協定。

ex.en: Bilateral talks will continue next week.
ex.zh: 雙邊會談將在下週繼續進行。

bilateral.en: involving two sides or two countries

ex.en: There was a big gold star on the door.
ex.zh: 門上有一顆大大的金色星星。

ex.en: This is the biggest cat that I've ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最大的貓。

ex.en: Do you have one a little bigger than these?
ex.zh: 有沒有比這些再大一點的？

ex.en: When the big earthquake occurred, I was just ten.
ex.zh: 大地震發生時，我才十歲。

ex.en: It's a big decision.
ex.zh: 這是個重大的決定。

ex.en: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
ex.zh: 可以請你說慢一點嗎？

ex.en: I'm a bit tired today.
ex.zh: 我今天有點累。

ex.en: There is a bit of whisky in this bottle.
ex.zh: 這瓶裡還有一點威士忌。

ex.en: Can I have a bit of cake?
ex.zh: 我可以吃一點蛋糕嗎？

ex.en: Tom tore the ticket to bits.
ex.zh: 湯姆把票撕成碎片。

ex.en: The vase broke into bits.
ex.zh: 花瓶摔得粉碎。

ex.en: A byte is made up of eight bits.
ex.zh: 一個位元組由八個位元組成。

ex.en: This computer runs a 64 bit system.
ex.zh: 這台電腦執行 64 位元的系統。

bit.en: the smallest unit of information in a computer

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現一隻翅膀受了重傷的鳥。

ex.en: The bird was half the size of a hawk.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥只有老鷹一半大。

bird.en: an animal with feathers and wings that usually can fly

bird.zh: kill two birds with one stone：一舉兩得、一石二鳥

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就能一舉兩得。

ex.en: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 騎腳踏車上班一舉兩得。

bird.en: to solve two problems with one action

ex.en: They bound the thief to a tree.
ex.zh: 他們把小偷綁在樹上。

ex.en: She bound the papers together with string.
ex.zh: 她用繩子把文件綁在一起。

bind.en: to tie something or someone with rope or string

ex.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
ex.zh: 深厚的友誼將我們緊緊連結在一起。

ex.en: Both parties are bound by the contract.
ex.zh: 雙方都受合約約束。

bind.en: to join people together or force them to keep a rule

ex.en: Such a plan is bound to fail.
ex.zh: 這種計畫注定會失敗。

ex.en: Jack is bound to succeed this time.
ex.zh: 傑克這次一定會成功。

bind.en: certain to happen or to do something

ex.en: He boarded a plane bound for Los Angeles.
ex.zh: 他登上一班飛往洛杉磯的飛機。

ex.en: This train is bound for Kaohsiung.
ex.zh: 這班列車開往高雄。

ex.en: Give your passport number and your date of birth.
ex.zh: 請提供你的護照號碼和出生日期。

ex.en: They were pleased at the birth of their first child.
ex.zh: 他們的第一個孩子出生了，他們很高興。

birth.en: the moment when a baby comes out of its mother

ex.en: She gave birth on Monday to her first child.
ex.zh: 她在星期一生下了第一個孩子。

ex.en: She will give birth to a child next month.
ex.zh: 她下個月要生了。

ex.en: His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.
ex.zh: 他的缺席引發了各種謠言。

birth.en: to produce a baby, or to cause something to start

ex.en: She is going to wash the bike this afternoon.
ex.zh: 她今天下午要洗腳踏車。

ex.en: I will give you a bike for your birthday.
ex.zh: 你生日時我送你一台腳踏車。

ex.en: I ride my bike to work every day.
ex.zh: 我每天騎腳踏車上班。

bike.en: a vehicle with two wheels, or a motorcycle

ex.en: Tom biked 30 km to the store to buy strawberries for his pregnant wife.
ex.zh: 湯姆為了懷孕的太太，騎了 30 公里的腳踏車到商店買草莓。

ex.en: We biked along the river on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們星期天沿著河邊騎腳踏車。

bike.en: to ride a vehicle with two wheels and pedals

ex.en: Toss it into the rubbish bin.
ex.zh: 把它丟進垃圾桶。

ex.en: Throw it in the bin.
ex.zh: 丟到垃圾桶裡。

ex.en: Please put your empty cans in the recycling bin.
ex.zh: 請把空罐放進資源回收桶。

bin.en: a container where you put things you throw away

ex.en: Hey, Tom, can we get two bins of lettuce?
ex.zh: 嘿，湯姆，我們可以買兩箱生菜嗎？

ex.en: Put your bag in the overhead bin.
ex.zh: 請把包包放在頭頂上方的置物櫃。

bin.en: a large container used for keeping things

ex.en: Scientists study the biological effects of stress.
ex.zh: 科學家研究壓力對生物體的影響。

ex.en: Sleep is a basic biological need.
ex.zh: 睡眠是基本的生理需求。

biological.en: connected with the science of living things

ex.en: He never met his biological father.
ex.zh: 他從沒見過他的親生父親。

ex.en: She is looking for her biological parents.
ex.zh: 她在尋找她的親生父母。

biological.en: related to you by birth, not by adoption

ex.en: I was biting my nails, worrying about you.
ex.zh: 我一邊咬指甲，一邊擔心你。

ex.en: If you bite me, then I'll bite you, too.
ex.zh: 你如果咬我，我也要咬你。

ex.en: Don't worry, the dog doesn't bite.
ex.zh: 別擔心，這隻狗不咬人。

bite.en: to cut or hold something with your teeth

ex.en: I got a lot of mosquito bites.
ex.zh: 我被蚊子叮了很多包。

ex.en: The snake bite needed immediate treatment.
ex.zh: 被蛇咬傷需要立即治療。

bite.en: a wound made when an animal or insect cuts your skin

bite.zh: 一口；（a bite）簡單吃點東西

ex.en: Can I have a bite of your sandwich?
ex.zh: 我可以吃一口你的三明治嗎？

ex.en: Let's grab a bite before the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會前我們去隨便吃點東西吧。

bite.en: an amount of food taken in one mouthful, or a small meal

bilingual.zh: 雙語的；會說兩種語言的

ex.en: I'm going to buy the bilingual dictionary next Saturday.
ex.zh: 我下週六要去買雙語辭典。

ex.en: They told me that they were bilingual.
ex.zh: 他們告訴我他們會說兩種語言。

ex.en: Being at least bilingual is a must in today's world.
ex.zh: 在當今世界，至少會兩種語言是必備的。

bilingual.en: using or able to speak two languages

ex.en: Computers store data in binary code.
ex.zh: 電腦以二進位碼儲存資料。

ex.en: Binary numbers use only 0 and 1.
ex.zh: 二進位數字只用 0 和 1。

ex.en: Don't see it as a binary choice.
ex.zh: 別把它看成非此即彼的選擇。

ex.en: This is not a simple binary question.
ex.zh: 這不是一個簡單的二選一問題。

binary.en: having two parts or only two possible choices

ex.en: Tom is studying to become a marine biologist.
ex.zh: 湯姆為了成為海洋生物學家而努力讀書。

ex.en: He is a biologist.
ex.zh: 他是生物學家。

biologist.en: a scientist who studies living things

ex.en: What a bizarre story!
ex.zh: 多麼離奇的故事！

ex.en: This is bizarre.
ex.zh: 真奇怪。

ex.en: That building's facade is bizarre. No idea what the architect was thinking.
ex.zh: 那棟大樓的外觀很怪，不知道建築師在想什麼。

ex.en: Our new ad will appear on billboards across the city.
ex.zh: 我們的新廣告會出現在全市的廣告看板上。

ex.en: I saw a huge billboard on the highway.
ex.zh: 我在高速公路上看到一個巨大的廣告看板。

billboard.en: a large sign outside that shows advertisements

ex.en: This beer tastes bitter.
ex.zh: 這種啤酒喝起來有苦味。

ex.en: Good medicine is bitter to the mouth.
ex.zh: 良藥苦口。

bitter.en: having a sharp, unpleasant taste that is not sweet

ex.en: His bitter words still rankle in my mind.
ex.zh: 他尖刻的話仍讓我耿耿於懷。

ex.en: They are bitter enemies.
ex.zh: 他們是死對頭。

ex.en: They said they weren't bitter.
ex.zh: 他們說他們並不怨恨。

bitter.en: feeling angry and unhappy about something unfair

ex.en: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
ex.zh: 幸好他身上的錢夠付帳。

ex.en: Tom took out his wallet and paid the bill.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿出錢包付了帳。

bill.en: a piece of paper showing how much money you must pay

ex.en: This little baby tore up a 10 dollar bill.
ex.zh: 這個小嬰兒把一張十美元的鈔票撕破了。

ex.en: Do you have change for a twenty-dollar bill?
ex.zh: 你有二十元鈔票的零錢可以換嗎？

ex.en: The bill was passed by Congress.
ex.zh: 這項法案被國會通過了。

ex.en: They voted against the new bill.
ex.zh: 他們投票反對新法案。

bill.en: a plan for a new law that is discussed by a government

ex.en: I binge-watched the whole season in one weekend.
ex.zh: 我一個週末就把整季追完了。

ex.en: Binge-watching until 3 a.m. is not good for your health.
ex.zh: 追劇追到凌晨三點對身體不好。

binge-watch.en: to watch many episodes of a TV show one after another

ex.en: We studied the binomial theorem in algebra class.
ex.zh: 我們在代數課上學了二項式定理。

ex.en: A binomial expression has exactly two terms.
ex.zh: 二項式恰好有兩項。

binomial.en: made of two terms in mathematics

ex.en: She wept bitterly.
ex.zh: 她痛哭。

ex.en: She cried bitterly.
ex.zh: 她痛哭了起來。

ex.en: Nakamatsu smiled bitterly at his own stupid question.
ex.zh: 中松為自己的愚蠢問題苦笑。

bitterly.en: in a very sad or angry way

ex.en: He couldn't stand the bitterness of the coffee.
ex.zh: 他受不了咖啡的苦味。

ex.en: Adding sugar cuts the bitterness of the tea.
ex.zh: 加糖可以減輕茶的苦味。

bitterness.en: a sharp, unpleasant taste that is not sweet

ex.en: She said good-bye with a smile, but there was a good deal of bitterness in her heart.
ex.zh: 她說再見的時候，臉上掛著笑容，但其實心中是十分難受的。

ex.en: There was a note of bitterness in his voice.
ex.zh: 他的聲音裡帶著一絲怨恨。

bitterness.en: a feeling of deep anger or sadness about something unfair

ex.en: People tend to look at others with bias.
ex.zh: 人們往往帶著偏見看待他人。

ex.en: The report shows a clear bias against young workers.
ex.zh: 這份報告明顯對年輕員工有偏見。

bias.en: an unfair preference for or against someone or something

ex.en: I'm not biased.
ex.zh: 我沒有偏見。

ex.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
ex.zh: 在這件事情上，我覺得那些垃圾媒體只報導偏頗的資訊。

bias.en: unfairly favoring one side or person

ex.en: The bill had bipartisan support.
ex.zh: 這項法案獲得兩黨支持。

ex.en: They formed a bipartisan committee.
ex.zh: 他們成立了一個跨黨派委員會。

ex.en: Keep the signed forms in this binder.
ex.zh: 請把簽好的表格放進這本活頁夾。

ex.en: Each department has a separate binder for records.
ex.zh: 每個部門都有一本獨立的資料活頁夾。

binder.en: a cover with rings for keeping loose papers

ex.en: Biotechnology has improved several medical tests.
ex.zh: 生物科技改善了好幾種醫療檢測。

ex.en: She works for a biotechnology company.
ex.zh: 她在一家生物科技公司工作。

biotechnology.en: the use of living things to make products or medicines

ex.en: The bistro serves seasonal dishes and local wine.
ex.zh: 這家小酒館供應當季料理和本地葡萄酒。

ex.en: We booked a table at a neighborhood bistro for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們預約了附近小餐館的晚餐座位。

ex.en: Some airports use biometric scanners instead of passports.
ex.zh: 有些機場用生物辨識掃描器取代護照查驗。

ex.en: You will need to provide biometric data such as fingerprints.
ex.zh: 你需要提供指紋等生物辨識資料。

biometric.en: using body features such as fingerprints to identify people

ex.en: Our company made a bid for the contract.
ex.zh: 我們公司投標了那份合約。

ex.en: The highest bid was 5,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 最高出價是 5,000 美元。

bid.en: an offer of money for something, or an offer to do work for a price

ex.en: How much did you bid?
ex.zh: 你出價多少？

ex.en: Three companies are bidding for the project.
ex.zh: 有三家公司在競標這個專案。

bid.en: to offer an amount of money for something

ex.en: He bade farewell to the students.
ex.zh: 他向學生們道別。

ex.en: We bid farewell to our old office.
ex.zh: 我們向舊辦公室道別。

bid.en: to say a greeting or goodbye to someone

ex.en: Once you sign, the contract is legally binding.
ex.zh: 一旦簽名，合約就具有法律約束力。

ex.en: This agreement is not binding.
ex.zh: 這份協議沒有約束力。

binding.en: that must be obeyed, especially by law

ex.en: The bishop gave a speech at the church ceremony.
ex.zh: 主教在教堂典禮上發表了演說。

ex.en: The new bishop was welcomed by the whole town.
ex.zh: 新任主教受到全鎮的歡迎。

ex.en: He moved his bishop across the chessboard.
ex.zh: 他把主教棋子移過棋盤。

ex.en: A bishop can only move diagonally.
ex.zh: 主教只能斜著走。

ex.en: I like to have a biscuit with my afternoon tea.
ex.zh: 我喜歡下午茶配一片餅乾。

ex.en: The baby chewed on a biscuit while we waited.
ex.zh: 我們等待的時候，寶寶啃著一片餅乾。

ex.en: The world has more than eight billion people.
ex.zh: 全世界有超過八十億人口。

ex.en: The project cost about a billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這個計畫花了大約十億元。

ex.en: Billions of stars fill our galaxy.
ex.zh: 我們的銀河系裡有數十億顆星星。

ex.en: Birmingham is one of the largest cities in England.
ex.zh: 伯明翰是英格蘭最大的城市之一。

ex.en: She took a train from Birmingham to London.
ex.zh: 她從伯明翰搭火車去倫敦。

ex.en: My grandmother keeps an old Bible on her bedside table.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在床頭櫃上放著一本舊聖經。

ex.en: The Bible has been translated into hundreds of languages.
ex.zh: 聖經已被翻譯成數百種語言。

ex.en: Billy loves building things with blocks.
ex.zh: 比利喜歡用積木蓋東西。

ex.en: Billy waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 比利在公車站等了二十分鐘。

ex.en: The movie tells a biblical story about a great flood.
ex.zh: 這部電影講述了一個聖經裡關於大洪水的故事。

ex.en: He often uses biblical phrases in his speeches.
ex.zh: 他在演講中常引用聖經裡的詞句。

ex.en: The liver makes bile to help digest fat.
ex.zh: 肝臟製造膽汁來幫助消化脂肪。

ex.en: Bile is stored in the gallbladder until the body needs it.
ex.zh: 膽汁儲存在膽囊裡，等身體需要時才釋放。

ex.en: The doctor took a small sample for a biopsy.
ex.zh: 醫生取了一小塊樣本做切片檢查。

ex.en: She is waiting for the result of her biopsy.
ex.zh: 她正在等候切片檢查的結果。

ex.en: He used binoculars to watch the birds across the lake.
ex.zh: 他用雙筒望遠鏡觀察湖對岸的鳥。

ex.en: Don't forget to bring your binoculars to the game.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶你的望遠鏡去看比賽。

ex.en: The actor got top billing in the new play.
ex.zh: 那位演員在這齣新戲中名列首位。

ex.en: She was unhappy with her billing on the poster.
ex.zh: 她對自己在海報上的排名不滿意。

ex.en: The billing department will send you an invoice by email.
ex.zh: 帳務部門會用電子郵件寄給你一張帳單。

ex.en: There was a mistake in the billing for last month.
ex.zh: 上個月的帳單開立出了錯。

ex.en: Please add a bibliography at the end of your paper.
ex.zh: 請在論文最後附上參考書目。

ex.en: The bibliography lists all the books I used.
ex.zh: 參考書目列出了我用到的所有書籍。

ex.en: The billionaire gave a large part of his money to charity.
ex.zh: 那位億萬富翁把大部分財產捐給了慈善機構。

ex.en: Few people become a billionaire before the age of thirty.
ex.zh: 很少人在三十歲前就成為億萬富翁。

ex.en: The bidding for the painting started at one thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 這幅畫的競標從一千元起跳。

ex.en: Bidding closes at noon tomorrow.
ex.zh: 競標明天中午截止。

ex.en: The servant did his master's bidding without question.
ex.zh: 僕人毫無疑問地照主人的吩咐去做。

ex.en: She refused to do his bidding any longer.
ex.zh: 她不願意再聽他使喚。

ex.en: I was bitten by a mosquito last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚被蚊子叮了。

ex.en: The dog has never bitten anyone.
ex.zh: 這隻狗從來沒咬過人。

ex.en: He had bitten off more than he could chew.
ex.zh: 他攬下了自己做不來的事。

ex.en: She packed a bikini for the beach trip.
ex.zh: 她為海灘之旅帶了一件比基尼。

ex.en: The shop sells a bikini in many bright colors.
ex.zh: 這家店販售各種鮮豔顏色的比基尼。

biker.zh: 騎機車的人、騎單車的人

ex.en: A group of bikers stopped at the cafe for lunch.
ex.zh: 一群騎士停在咖啡館吃午餐。

ex.en: The biker wore a helmet and gloves.
ex.zh: 那位騎士戴著安全帽和手套。

ex.en: Wood and crop waste are common sources of biomass.
ex.zh: 木材和農作物廢料是常見的生質來源。

ex.en: Scientists measure the biomass of the forest each year.
ex.zh: 科學家每年測量這片森林的生物量。

ex.en: The biographer spent five years researching her life.
ex.zh: 那位傳記作家花了五年研究她的生平。

ex.en: A famous biographer wrote the story of the scientist.
ex.zh: 一位知名的傳記作家寫了那位科學家的故事。

ex.en: The book contains biographical details about the poet.
ex.zh: 這本書收錄了關於那位詩人的生平細節。

ex.en: She watched a biographical film about a famous singer.
ex.zh: 她看了一部關於知名歌手的傳記電影。

bipolar.zh: 躁鬱症的；雙相情緒障礙的

ex.en: She was diagnosed with bipolar disorder in college.
ex.zh: 她大學時被診斷出雙相情緒障礙。

ex.en: Bipolar patients can have both high and low moods.
ex.zh: 雙相情緒障礙的患者可能同時有情緒高昂與低落的時期。

ex.en: The magnet has a bipolar structure with north and south ends.
ex.zh: 這塊磁鐵具有南北兩極的雙極結構。

ex.en: A bipolar transistor has three layers of material.
ex.zh: 雙極電晶體由三層材料構成。

ex.en: The judge was accused of being biased against the defendant.
ex.zh: 法官被指控對被告抱有偏見。

ex.en: A biased report can mislead readers.
ex.zh: 偏頗的報導可能誤導讀者。

ex.en: A herd of bison crossed the open plain.
ex.zh: 一群野牛穿越了開闊的平原。

ex.en: We saw a huge bison at the national park.
ex.zh: 我們在國家公園裡看到一隻巨大的野牛。

ex.en: The lab studies biochemical reactions in cells.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室研究細胞中的生化反應。

ex.en: A biochemical test showed the level of sugar in his blood.
ex.zh: 生化檢驗顯示了他血液中的糖分含量。

ex.en: She works for a small biotech company that develops new medicines.
ex.zh: 她任職於一家研發新藥的小型生物科技公司。

ex.en: Biotech is a fast-growing industry.
ex.zh: 生物科技是快速成長的產業。

ex.en: Look at the little birdie on the branch!
ex.zh: 看樹枝上那隻小鳥！

ex.en: The mother pointed to a birdie in the tree.
ex.zh: 媽媽指著樹上的一隻小鳥。

birdie.zh: 博蒂（高爾夫球，比標準桿少一桿）

ex.en: He scored a birdie on the final hole.
ex.zh: 他在最後一洞打出一記博蒂。

ex.en: A birdie put her in the lead.
ex.zh: 一記博蒂讓她領先。

ex.en: A tall birch tree stands in our garden.
ex.zh: 我們的花園裡有一棵高大的樺樹。

ex.en: The white bark of the birch is easy to recognize.
ex.zh: 樺樹白色的樹皮很容易辨認。

ex.en: The table is made of birch.
ex.zh: 這張桌子是樺木做的。

ex.en: Birch is often used for light furniture.
ex.zh: 樺木常被用來做輕巧的家具。

ex.en: This small house is the birthplace of the famous poet.
ex.zh: 這間小屋是那位著名詩人的出生地。

ex.en: The city is often called the birthplace of jazz.
ex.zh: 這座城市常被稱為爵士樂的發源地。

bittersweet.zh: 又苦又甜的；苦樂參半的

ex.en: Leaving my hometown was a bittersweet moment.
ex.zh: 離開家鄉是個苦樂參半的時刻。

ex.en: This dark chocolate has a bittersweet taste.
ex.zh: 這種黑巧克力帶有又苦又甜的味道。

ex.en: Grandma plays bingo with her friends every Friday night.
ex.zh: 奶奶每週五晚上都和朋友玩賓果。

ex.en: We played bingo at the school party and won small prizes.
ex.zh: 我們在學校派對上玩賓果，贏了一些小獎品。

ex.en: Bingo! That is exactly the answer I was looking for.
ex.zh: 答對了！這正是我在找的答案。

ex.en: I tried one more key, and bingo, the door opened.
ex.zh: 我再試了一把鑰匙，中了，門打開了。

ex.en: She works in a biomedical research laboratory.
ex.zh: 她在一間生物醫學研究實驗室工作。

ex.en: He studies biomedical engineering at university.
ex.zh: 他在大學主修生物醫學工程。

ex.en: He does curls to build up his biceps.
ex.zh: 他做彎舉來鍛鍊二頭肌。

ex.en: She felt a sharp pain in her right biceps.
ex.zh: 她右邊的二頭肌感到一陣劇痛。

ex.en: The birds sing outside my window every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早上鳥兒都在我窗外歌唱。

ex.en: Many birds fly south for the winter.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類冬天會飛往南方。

ex.en: Black smoke began to billow from the old factory.
ex.zh: 黑煙開始從舊工廠裡滾滾冒出。

ex.en: The curtains billow in the breeze when the window is open.
ex.zh: 窗戶開著時，窗簾會隨微風鼓動。

ex.en: A great billow of steam rose from the pot.
ex.zh: 一大團蒸氣從鍋子裡升起。

ex.en: The small boat rose and fell on each billow.
ex.zh: 小船隨著每一道巨浪起伏。

ex.en: After the exams, they went on a shopping binge.
ex.zh: 考試結束後，他們瘋狂購物了一番。

ex.en: A late-night binge of snacks made her feel sick.
ex.zh: 她深夜暴食零食，結果覺得不舒服。

binge.zh: 狂吃；一口氣大量做某事

ex.en: I tend to binge on chips when I'm stressed.
ex.zh: 我壓力大的時候，常常狂吃洋芋片。

ex.en: We binged the whole series in one weekend.
ex.zh: 我們一個週末就把整部影集看完了。

ex.en: Biologically, humans and chimpanzees are closely related.
ex.zh: 在生物學上，人類和黑猩猩的親緣關係很近。

ex.en: The twins are biologically brothers but grew up apart.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎在生理上是兄弟，卻在不同的地方長大。

ex.en: The two brothers bicker about everything.
ex.zh: 那兩兄弟什麼事都要吵。

ex.en: Stop bickering and help me carry these boxes.
ex.zh: 別吵了，過來幫我搬這些箱子。

ex.en: The speech was a strong stand against bigotry.
ex.zh: 這場演講堅定地反對偏見。

ex.en: Bigotry can make people treat others unfairly.
ex.zh: 偏見會讓人不公平地對待他人。

ex.en: The dog is biting the bone.
ex.zh: 那隻狗正在啃骨頭。

ex.en: Stop biting your nails, please.
ex.zh: 請不要再咬指甲了。

ex.en: A biting wind blew across the field.
ex.zh: 刺骨的寒風吹過田野。

ex.en: We waited for the bus in the biting cold.
ex.zh: 我們在刺骨的寒冷中等公車。

ex.en: Her biting comment hurt his feelings.
ex.zh: 她尖刻的評語傷了他的感情。

ex.en: The film is a biting satire of modern life.
ex.zh: 這部電影是對現代生活的辛辣諷刺。

ex.en: The biosphere includes all living things on Earth.
ex.zh: 生物圈包含地球上所有的生物。

ex.en: Pollution can damage the delicate biosphere.
ex.zh: 污染可能破壞脆弱的生物圈。

ex.en: They spent the evening in a small billiard hall.
ex.zh: 他們在一間小撞球館度過了那個晚上。

ex.en: He bought a green billiard table for the basement.
ex.zh: 他買了一張綠色的撞球桌放在地下室。

ex.en: The bishops met to discuss the new church rules.
ex.zh: 主教們聚在一起討論教會的新規定。

ex.en: Several bishops from different countries attended the service.
ex.zh: 來自不同國家的幾位主教出席了禮拜。

ex.en: In chess, bishops can only move diagonally.
ex.zh: 在西洋棋中，主教只能斜走。

ex.en: He lost both of his bishops early in the game.
ex.zh: 他在比賽早期就失去了兩個主教。

ex.en: She is studying biochemistry at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修生物化學。

ex.en: Biochemistry explains how our bodies break down food.
ex.zh: 生物化學解釋了我們的身體如何分解食物。

ex.en: Can I borrow your biro for a second?
ex.zh: 我可以借你的原子筆用一下嗎？

ex.en: She signed the form with a blue biro.
ex.zh: 她用藍色原子筆在表格上簽名。

bigot.zh: 心胸狹隘、固執偏見的人

ex.en: He refused to be called a bigot, but his comments were full of prejudice.
ex.zh: 他不肯被叫作偏執的人，但他的言論充滿偏見。

ex.en: A bigot rarely listens to opinions different from his own.
ex.zh: 偏執的人很少聽進與自己不同的意見。

ex.en: Please send me a short bio for the event program.
ex.zh: 請寄給我一份簡短的個人簡介，用在活動手冊上。

ex.en: Her bio says she grew up in a small fishing town.
ex.zh: 她的簡介上寫著她在一個小漁村長大。

ex.en: He was appointed to the bishopric in 1850.
ex.zh: 他在一八五〇年被任命為主教。

ex.en: The bishopric covered several towns and villages.
ex.zh: 這個主教轄區涵蓋好幾個城鎮和村莊。

ex.en: Bicarbonate of soda is often used in baking.
ex.zh: 小蘇打常被用在烘焙上。

ex.en: The water contains a small amount of bicarbonate.
ex.zh: 這水含有少量的碳酸氫鹽。

ex.en: The library keeps a bibliographic record for every book it owns.
ex.zh: 圖書館為每一本館藏書籍都保留書目紀錄。

ex.en: Please check the bibliographic details before you cite the article.
ex.zh: 引用這篇文章之前，請先核對書目資料。

ex.en: Humans have binocular vision, which helps us judge distance.
ex.zh: 人類有雙眼視覺，能幫助我們判斷距離。

ex.en: Binocular vision lets the owl see its prey clearly.
ex.zh: 雙眼視覺讓貓頭鷹能清楚看見獵物。

ex.en: Several bigwigs from the company attended the dinner.
ex.zh: 公司幾位大人物出席了晚宴。

ex.en: He became a political bigwig in the town.
ex.zh: 他成了鎮上有分量的政界要角。

birthright.zh: 與生俱來的權利；長子繼承權

ex.en: Clean water should be the birthright of every child.
ex.zh: 乾淨的水應該是每個孩子與生俱來的權利。

ex.en: In the story, he sold his birthright for a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 故事裡，他為了一碗湯賣掉了長子繼承權。

ex.en: You must bide your time and wait for the right moment.
ex.zh: 你得耐心等待，等到適當的時機。

ex.en: He decided to bide in the village until the storm passed.
ex.zh: 他決定留在村子裡，等暴風雨過去。

ex.en: They play billiards at the club every Friday.
ex.zh: 他們每週五在俱樂部打撞球。

ex.en: My grandfather taught me how to play billiards.
ex.zh: 我爺爺教我怎麼打撞球。

ex.en: The bicyclist stopped at the red light.
ex.zh: 那位騎自行車的人在紅燈前停下。

ex.en: A bicyclist rode along the river every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早上都有位騎自行車的人沿著河邊騎。

ex.en: A straight line bisects the circle into two equal halves.
ex.zh: 一條直線把圓分成相等的兩半。

ex.en: The river bisects the town, with a bridge at each end.
ex.zh: 河流把小鎮劈成兩半，兩端各有一座橋。

ex.en: The government trains hospitals to respond to bioterrorism.
ex.zh: 政府訓練醫院如何因應生物恐怖攻擊。

ex.en: Experts discussed how to prevent bioterrorism.
ex.zh: 專家們討論了如何預防生物恐怖主義。

ex.en: The two brothers were bickering over who got the bigger slice.
ex.zh: 兄弟倆為了誰分到比較大塊在吵嘴。

ex.en: Stop bickering and help me carry these boxes.
ex.zh: 別再吵了，過來幫我搬這些箱子。

ex.en: The constant bickering in the office wore everyone out.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡不斷的口角讓每個人都很疲憊。

ex.en: There was a lot of bickering about where to eat.
ex.zh: 大家為了要去哪裡吃飯吵了很久。

ex.en: She is studying bioethics at medical school.
ex.zh: 她在醫學院研讀生物倫理學。

ex.en: Bioethics asks whether new medical treatments are right to use.
ex.zh: 生物倫理學探討新的醫療方式是否合乎道德。

ex.en: She tied a bib around the baby before the meal.
ex.zh: 用餐前，她在寶寶脖子上繫了一條圍兜。

ex.en: The baby's bib was covered with orange carrot puree.
ex.zh: 寶寶的圍兜沾滿了橘色的胡蘿蔔泥。

ex.en: The town held a big parade to celebrate its bicentennial.
ex.zh: 小鎮舉辦盛大遊行來慶祝建鎮兩百週年。

ex.en: The museum printed a special book for the bicentennial.
ex.zh: 博物館為兩百週年紀念印製了一本特別的書。

ex.en: She uses biofeedback to learn how to lower her stress.
ex.zh: 她用生物回饋法學習降低壓力。

ex.en: The clinic offers biofeedback training for people with headaches.
ex.zh: 診所為頭痛患者提供生物回饋訓練。

ex.en: The city holds a biennial art festival.
ex.zh: 這座城市每兩年舉辦一次藝術節。

ex.en: Our biennial meeting will take place next spring.
ex.zh: 我們兩年一次的會議將在明年春天舉行。
